using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        // We will test TrySetSlotRangesAsync focusing on the logger calls including LogTrace on line 50 and line 66.

        // We need to fake or mock dependencies: migrateOperation, client, logger, ClusterManager.GetRange, etc.
        // Since the class is internal sealed partial, we will use reflection or internal access if needed.
        // For simplicity, we will create a derived test class that exposes TrySetSlotRangesAsync for testing.

        private class TestMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            public TestMigrateSession(
                Mock<ILogger> loggerMock,
                Mock<IClient> clientMock,
                string[] slots,
                string[] slotRanges)
            {
                this.logger = loggerMock.Object;
                this.migrateOperation = new[] { new MigrateOperation { Client = clientMock.Object } };
                this._sslots = slots;
                this._slotRanges = slotRanges;
                this._timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
                this._cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            }

            // Expose protected/internal members for test
            public new ILogger logger;
            public new MigrateOperation[] migrateOperation;
            public new string[] _sslots;
            public new string[] _slotRanges;
            public new TimeSpan _timeout;
            public new CancellationTokenSource _cts;

            // Override CheckConnectionAsync to return true by default
            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(IClient client) => Task.FromResult(true);

            // Override ClusterManager.GetRange to return a string representation of slots
            public static string GetRange(string[] slots) => string.Join(",", slots);

            // Override client.SetSlotRange to return "OK" by default
            public interface IClient
            {
                Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, string[] slotRanges);
            }

            public class MigrateOperation
            {
                public IClient Client { get; set; }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSendAndComplete()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<TestMigrateSession.IClient>();
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string[]>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("OK");

            var slots = new[] { "1", "2", "3" };
            var slotRanges = new[] { "range1", "range2" };

            var session = new TestMigrateSession(loggerMock, clientMock, slots, slotRanges);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);

            // Verify LogTrace called with "Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE {state} {nodeid} {slots}"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify LogTrace called with "[Completed] SETSLOT {slots} {state} {nodeid}"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionLoggerTests
    {
        // We cannot access internal sealed MigrateSession directly, so we test the logging behavior indirectly
        // by mocking dependencies and invoking TrySetSlotRangesAsync via reflection.

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSendAndComplete()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<IClient>();
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string[]>()))
                .ReturnsAsync("OK");

            var migrateOperation = new[] { new MigrateOperation { Client = clientMock.Object } };

            var migrateSessionType = typeof(MigrateSession);
            var ctor = migrateSessionType.GetConstructor(
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic,
                null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
            Assert.NotNull(ctor);

            var session = ctor.Invoke(null);

            // Set private fields via reflection
            var loggerField = migrateSessionType.GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            loggerField.SetValue(session, loggerMock.Object);

            var migrateOperationField = migrateSessionType.GetField("migrateOperation", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            migrateOperationField.SetValue(session, migrateOperation);

            var sslotsField = migrateSessionType.GetField("_sslots", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            sslotsField.SetValue(session, new string[] { "1", "2", "3" });

            var slotRangesField = migrateSessionType.GetField("_slotRanges", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            slotRangesField.SetValue(session, new string[] { "range1", "range2" });

            var timeoutField = migrateSessionType.GetField("_timeout", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            timeoutField.SetValue(session, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));

            var ctsField = migrateSessionType.GetField("_cts", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            ctsField.SetValue(session, new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource());

            // Override CheckConnectionAsync to always return true by replacing method via delegate is not possible here,
            // so we assume it returns true or the test will fail.

            // Act
            var method = migrateSessionType.GetMethod("TrySetSlotRangesAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            var task = (Task<bool>)method.Invoke(session, new object[] { "node1", MigrateState.STABLE });
            var result = await task;

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);

            // Verify LogTrace called with "Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE {state} {nodeid} {slots}"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);

            // Verify LogTrace called with "[Completed] SETSLOT {slots} {state} {nodeid}"
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        // Interfaces and classes to mock dependencies
        private interface IClient
        {
            Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, string[] slotRanges);
        }

        private class MigrateOperation
        {
            public IClient Client { get; set; }
        }
    }
}
